_doc: Historical-flavoured random events (all fictional). chancePerYear = probability per year while in era and not active or cooling down; months = [min, max] duration (0 = permanent technology). Effects multiply (revenue/supply by cargo id or by group: people, bulk, industrial, farm, consumer, or 'all'), except interest (added to bond rates) and confidence (added once). See BALANCING.md.

events.name: War
events.headline: War breaks out! Armies need steel, coal and food; travel and credit suffer.

events.name: Gold rush
events.headline: Gold found in the hills! Fortune seekers flood the railways.

events.name: Oil boom
events.headline: Oil boom: new wells gush and refineries buy all the crude they can get.

events.name: Rail workers' strike
events.headline: Rail workers strike for better pay: maintenance and construction cost more.

events.name: Bad harvest
events.headline: Drought ruins the harvest: grain is scarce and food prices climb.

events.name: Bumper harvest
events.headline: Bumper harvest: farms overflow with grain.

events.name: Coal miners' strike
events.headline: Coal miners walk out: coal runs short and fuel prices jump.

events.name: Building boom
events.headline: Building boom: towns grow fast and buy lumber, cement and steel.

events.name: Epidemic
events.headline: Fever spreads through the towns: people stay home.

events.name: Air brakes
events.headline: New technology: air brakes become standard — fewer accidents and breakdowns.

events.name: Steel rails
events.headline: New technology: steel rails last longer — track upkeep falls.

events.name: Standard time
events.headline: Standard time zones adopted: timetables make sense and travel grows.

events.name: Refrigerated cars
events.headline: New technology: ice-cooled cars keep food and milk fresh for longer journeys.
